system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: 任务 prompt 以 markdown 文件形式随代码分发，并通过 `runtime.prompt_group` 选择目录
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are markdown files with placeholders like {origin}, {goal}, {graph_yaml} rendered per task.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Agent Workers run an OODA loop — Observe the full graph, Orient to the current state, Decide on next intents, Act to explore
env_context_strategy.note: Worker CLIs explore inside container; graph_yaml snapshot also injected into prompt.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Agent Workers only receive a prompt and return structured output
context_compaction.note: Each task is a single-shot prompt to a worker; no history-compaction mechanism in dispatcher.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Dispatcher 固定从 `stdout` 取全文作为模型正文输出

tool_call_format.note: From Cairn's perspective workers return structured JSON parsed by the dispatcher output_parser.

tool_count.note: Cairn exposes no tool schema to a model; workers are external CLI agents whose tool sets are not enumerated in the repo.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: 在当前容器内执行任务
edit_primitive.note: No edit tool in Cairn itself; file editing delegated to external worker CLIs (claude code/codex).

tool_schema_source.note: Output contracts authored by hand in markdown prompts/contracts.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Zero MCP tools, zero RAG, zero predefined agent roles.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: it searches for a path through an unknown state space
loop_primitives.note: OODA loop per worker (react) over a fact-intent graph searched from origin to goal (state-space search).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The graph grows from `origin` toward `goal`. Every new Fact is a stepping stone; every Intent is a step into the unknown.
planning_granularity.note: Fact-intent graph stored on server and re-read across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Cairn Dispatcher reads the graph, schedules tasks, spins up and tears down worker containers
multi_agent_topology.note: Workers coordinate only via the shared board (stigmergy).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: spins up and tears down worker containers, and is the sole writer to the protocol

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Hint | Human judgment injected at any time; absorbed by agents on the next read
human_in_loop.note: Hints are steering input, not a gating/approval point; no per-action approval.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The engine is built on a **Blackboard Architecture** with an explicit fact-intent graph.

long_term_memory.note: Skill files shipped in the worker container.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: 若项目曾 `completed` 后又被服务端显式 `reopen` 为 `active`
state_persistence.note: Graph state persisted to ./datas/cairn/; projects can be stopped, reopened and continued.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Reads the full graph: is the goal met? What should be explored next?
self_verification.note: The reason task is an LLM reviewing the graph state to judge completion.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: 两阶段都失败则 release 保留 intent，下轮仍按新项目重试
retry_policy.note: Failed tasks release the intent and are retried in later rounds; search continues until goal complete, no fixed cap.

rollback.evidence_quote: spins up and tears down worker containers
rollback.note: No revert/undo of in-container changes in the dispatcher loop; containers torn down on cleanup.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 主阶段成功时固定返回 `fact + complete`
termination_condition.note: Completion is declared when goal met (complete); per-task timeouts also apply.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: 在剩余 Worker 中，优先选择 `priority` 更小的
cost_controls.note: Priority-based worker/model selection; concurrency caps (max_running) also present, no token budget.

timeouts.evidence_quote: 超时策略按任务类型定义
timeouts.note: timeout / conclude_timeout / healthcheck_timeout per task; no run-level wall-clock cap found.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each project gets its own Worker Container; multiple Agent Workers run concurrently inside it.

filesystem_access.note: Workers run with skip-permissions, full access within container.

network_policy.note: Container provides network for pentest targets; no egress restriction configured.

permission_model.note: Workers run with approvals/sandbox bypassed; no action authorization gate.

tracing.evidence_quote: `GET /projects/{project_id}/export?format=yaml`：仅用于构造 prompt 所需的图快照
tracing.note: Fact-intent graph is a structured record; dispatcher also emits status-change logs.

replayability.note: State persisted but no trajectory replay facility described.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The system had never been tested before the competition.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner ships in the repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Zero MCP tools, zero RAG, zero predefined agent roles.
guardrails.note: No input/output/action guardrails in the harness; explore contract explicitly forbids refusal.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Cairn is a general-purpose problem-solving engine.
target_domain.note: Validated first on autonomous penetration testing / security (other).

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is licensed under **GNU AGPLv3** for personal and educational use.

model_agnostic.note: Configurable base_url/model per worker in dispatch.yaml.

first_release_date.note: Basis: v0.2.1 tag date (only tag provided).

stars.note: Star count not provided in evidence.
